description: Follow something in a video clip frame by frame (motion tracking, in the editor: an open tab, else headless Chrome / Edge) and store it on the clip as a named track (props.tracks). Then, in the same call, make a mask follow it (apply:{mask}) or pin another clip to it (apply:{clip} — a title, sticker, blur box… its x / y, and optionally scale / rotation, get keyframes that ride on the track, keeping where it is at `at`). What to follow: region {x, y, w, h} or point {x, y} (+ size), as fractions of the clip's picture (0…1, y down) at time `at`; or leave both out with apply:{mask} to follow what that mask covers. To re-apply an existing track, pass its name with apply and no region. Pick something with detail (a corner, a logo, text, an eye), not a flat area; the result reports match quality (≥ 0.8 is solid) and where the region was lost, if it was. Check the outcome with fablecut_scopes or by looking at the keyed clip.

apply.description: Bake the track into keys: {mask: index | name} (the mask's x / y — and scale / rotation when tracked — follow) or {clip: id, scale?, rotation?, at?} (that clip rides on the track)

at.description: Timeline seconds where the region is as given (default: the clip's start)

clip.description: The video clip to track in

direction.description: Track from `at` to the clip's end (default), to its start, or both

force.description: Allow changing locked clips — only when the user asked

name.description: The track's name (default: the mask's name, or Track n). An existing name is extended / replaced over the tracked range

point.description: A spot to follow at `at` (fractions of the picture); a square region of `size` around it is matched

region.description: The area to follow at `at`: centre x, y and size w, h, fractions of the clip's picture

scale.description: Also follow the region's size (zooms, objects moving closer)

size.description: With point: the region's width, fraction of the picture's width (default 0.08)

to.description: Timeline seconds to stop at (default: the clip's end / start)

where.description: auto (default): an open editor tab, else headless · tab · headless

name: fablecut_track
